content:
While iOS 27 has become the new focus of preview software, Apple is still preparing iOS 26.6 as the next iPhone update. Apple has just released the first release candidate of iOS 26.6. The iOS 26.6 beta has been in testing since the end of May.

What's new in iOS 26.6

So far, we have found two notable changes in the iOS 26.6 beta.

First, there is an adjustment to the limit on the number of contacts that can be blocked. Second, a new iPhone anti-theft feature appears to be in development.

This update may also pre-build Spotlight indexes on iPhone and iPad for Siri AI to use in iOS 27. The release candidate released today confirms this for the first time in its release notes.

Not many more new features and changes are expected, as all focus has now shifted to iOS 27.

Apple's next major software update will arrive in September, with the company continuing to iterate iOS 27 throughout the summer.

iOS 26.6 will be the next official release following iOS 26 and the subsequent releases since last autumn.

Last year, the first beta of iOS 18.6 was released after the first beta of iOS 26. This means iOS 26.6 is arriving slightly earlier than Apple's 2025 release cycle.
